steps.eval: (() => { const d = document.querySelector('[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]'); if (!d) throw new Error('编辑抽屉未打开'); const title = (d.querySelector('h2')?.innerText || '').trim(); if (!title.includes('编辑')) throw new Error('抽屉不是编辑态: ' + title); const remember = [...d.querySelectorAll('[role="switch"]')][0]; if (!remember) throw new Error('找不到「保存密码」开关'); if (remember.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true') throw new Error('编辑态「保存密码」开关应默认开启（这是「卡片编辑无法保存密码」的回归锚点），实际 ' + remember.getAttribute('aria-checked')); const pwd = [...d.querySelectorAll('input')].find((i) => i.type === 'password'); if (!pwd) throw new Error('找不到密码输入框'); return { opened: true, rememberDefaultOn: true, passwordPlaceholder: pwd.placeholder }; })()

(() => { const d = document.querySelector('[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]'); if (!d) throw new Error('输入密码后抽屉被关闭'); const save = [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find((n) => (n.innerText || '').trim() === '保存'); if (!save) throw new Error('找不到「保存」按钮'); if (save.disabled) throw new Error('只改密码时「保存」不应禁用（isDirty 未把 password 计入）'); return { saveEnabled: true }; })()

(async () => { if (document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]')) throw new Error('保存后抽屉未关闭（可能主进程报错被 toast 吞掉前就断言了）'); const list = await window.api.connections.list(); const c = list.data.find((x) => x.name.includes('内网-01')); if (!c) throw new Error('找不到内网-01'); if (c.hasCredential !== true) throw new Error('保存后 hasCredential 应为 true，实际 ' + c.hasCredential + '（密码未落库）'); return { drawerClosed: true, hasCredential: true }; })()

(() => { const d = document.querySelector('[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]'); if (!d) throw new Error('重开编辑抽屉未打开'); const pwd = [...d.querySelectorAll('input')].find((i) => i.type === 'password'); if (!pwd) throw new Error('重开后找不到密码输入框'); if (pwd.placeholder !== '已保存，留空表示不修改') throw new Error('重开后密码框应显示「已保存，留空表示不修改」，实际: ' + pwd.placeholder); const remember = [...d.querySelectorAll('[role="switch"]')][0]; if (remember.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true') throw new Error('重开后「保存密码」开关应保持开启'); return { reopened: true, savedPlaceholder: true, rememberStillOn: true }; })()
